'''Grenade droids''', also known as '''grenadier droids''' or '''B1 grenadier troopers''', were a [[Grenadier/Legends|grenadier]] variant of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Variants included the '''thermal detonator battle droid''' and '''B1 Grenadier Assault'''.

==Description==
[[File:Droid_grenadier.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A thermal detonator battle droid.]]
Like the B1 battle droids, Grenade droids, or B1 grenadier troopers,<ref name="Adventures">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref> were bipedal with two arms and two legs and had black sensors, and featured green markings to identify their model. They operated by throwing [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] at their targets.<ref name="OW" /> Thermal detonator battle droids carried [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]] which fired [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] for light anti-armor roles. These units were effective against mechanical and shielded targets and were not as effective against buildings and non-mechanical targets. Droid grenadiers carried their mortars while walking and deployed it while still.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
[[File:B1_grenadier_droid.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A B1 grenade droid on Umbara]]
Grenade droids were used during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Grenadier droids were stationed throughout the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and [[Capture of Theed/Legends|were engaged]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. During the closing portion of the invasion, more of the droids tried to prevent [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Kenobi from taking out]] a [[Quad turbolaser cannon (Trade Federation)|quad turbolaser cannon]].<ref name="OW" /> One thermal detonator battle droid was used in the opening stages of the invasion. Ten more accompanied the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] during the [[Invasion of Spinnaker|attack]] on the city of [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]].<ref name="GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
More were built at Trade Federation [[Barracks/Legends|Troop centers]] at the order of OOM-9.<ref name="GB" />
{{Endgame}}

All units of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] on Naboo were eventually shut down after the destruction of the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']].<ref name="OW" /> B1 grenadier droids later served within the ranks of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], including during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]<ref name="Umbara" /> and the [[third battle of Felucia]].<ref name="Felucia">{{TCWA|loc=Felucia}}</ref> An augmented version was the B1 Grenadier Assault.<ref name="Adventures" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grenade droids appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']].<ref name="OW" /> The thermal detonator battle droid appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''<ref name="GB" /> and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].<ref name="GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> They were provided to the player (in the role of OOM-9) in two missions and more could be built in single- or multiplayer.<ref name="GB" />
